subject: Deadline extension: 2026 Meeting SEM Working Group: Call for Papers

messages.subject: Deadline extension: 2026 Meeting SEM Working Group: Call for Papers
parts:
Dear Colleagues,

We are pleased to inform you that the deadline for abstract submission for the SEM Working Group Meeting has been extended to December 15.

Abstracts can be submitted via the form linked here. 

The SEM WG Meeting will take place in Warsaw, Poland, on April 15–17, 2026.

Kind regards,

The Organizing Committee
